scripts.title: DevConqueror Universal Panel Keyless
scripts.features:
MAIN TAB
INF HP – Toggle to set the player's health and max health to 1,000,000,000.

FLY MODE – Toggle to enable flight.

FLY SPEED – Slider to adjust flying speed (range: 10 – 500).

WALK SPEED – Slider to adjust walking speed (range: 16 – 500).

NOCLIP – Toggle to make the player's character parts non-collidable.

INF JUMP – Toggle to enable infinite jumping.

Joke Button – A yellow button that teleports the player to a specific game (Place ID: 92544971388901).

TELEPORT TAB
ALT + CLICK TP – Toggle to teleport to the mouse hit position when holding Left Alt + left-click.

GIVE TP TOOL – Button that gives a tool in the backpack. Clicking the tool teleports you to the mouse hit position.

AUTO TP TO HUMANoid – Toggle to automatically teleport your character to the nearest humanoid (other NPC/player) at a set height.

TP HEIGHT – Slider to adjust the height offset when auto-teleporting (range: 0 – 50).

AUTO FACE CHARACTER – Toggle to automatically rotate your character to face the nearest humanoid.

AUTO FACE CAMERA – Toggle to automatically rotate the camera to look at the nearest humanoid.

COMBAT TAB
TARGET: Head – Clickable button that cycles through aim parts (Head → HumanoidRootPart → Torso → Left Arm → Right Arm → Left Leg → Right Leg → Humanoid).

AIMLOCK – Toggle to lock the camera onto the selected player's chosen body part.

AIM SMOOTH – Slider to adjust the smoothness of the aimlock (range: 0.01 – 1.0).

HITBOX – Toggle to expand the hitbox of all other players (sets HRP.Size to 15,15,15) and makes it visible.

AUTO CLICK – Toggle to automatically simulate a click (changes Humanoid state to Running) while the left mouse button is held.

CLICK SPEED – Slider to adjust the click interval for Auto Click (range: 0.01 – 1.0 seconds).

VISUAL TAB
PLAYER ESP – Toggle to enable a colored Highlight effect on all other players.

FULL BRIGHT – Toggle to increase Lighting.Brightness to 2 and disable global shadows.

FPS BOOST – Toggle that disables textures/decals (sets transparency to 1), disables particle emitters/trails, and changes part materials to SmoothPlastic to improve performance.

MISC TAB
REJOIN – Button to teleport the player back to the same game (rejoin).

SERVER HOP – Button to teleport to the same game (effectively a server hop, identical to rejoin in this script).

TP TO PLAYER – Button that teleports your character to the currently selected player (from the right-side player list) with a 3-stud offset behind them.

ANTI AFK – Toggle that periodically forces the character to jump and then run to avoid being kicked for inactivity.

AUTO COLLECT – Toggle that automatically teleports your character to nearby collectible items (detects names containing: coin, gem, drop, collect, pickup, token, loot, or objects with TouchTransmitter/ProximityPrompt/ClickDetector).

COLLECT RADIUS – Slider to adjust the search radius for Auto Collect (range: 5 – 100).

3RD PERSON – Toggle to increase the camera zoom distance to 500 (allowing third-person view).

INFO TAB
"DevConqueror Panel" – Title label.

"Discord Server" – Label with a "Copy Discord" button (copies https://discord.gg/ReUKcupgDn to clipboard).

Game 1 Button – Teleports to "Rng Skill Fights Beta" (Place ID: 109479739036928).

Game 2 Button – Teleports to "Escape From Jungle Warriors" (Place ID: 102210905913074).

Game 3 Button – Teleports to "Rng Skill Fights" (Place ID: 92544971388901).

GLOBAL UI FEATURES
Toggle UI: Press the K key to show/hide the entire GUI panel.

scripts.title: Adidas script, Works even if u res*.
scripts.script:
-- wait for the local player to fully load into the game
local player = game.Players.LocalPlayer
while not player do
    task.wait()
    player = game.Players.LocalPlayer
end

local runService = game:GetService("RunService")
local currentSpeedConnection = nil

-- stop all currently playing animation tracks to prevent overlapping states
local function StopAnimations(character)
    local animateScript = character:WaitForChild("Animate")
    local humanoid = character:WaitForChild("Humanoid")
    local animator = humanoid:WaitForChild("Animator")

    animateScript.Disabled = false
    for _, track in pairs(animator:GetPlayingAnimationTracks()) do
        track:Stop()
    end
end

-- apply the custom animation asset IDs, speed 16.5, and slightly increased playback pacing
local function ApplyCustomAnimations(character)
    local humanoid = character:WaitForChild("Humanoid")

    -- verify that the character is using the R15 rig type before proceeding
    if humanoid.RigType ~= Enum.HumanoidRigType.R15 then
        warn("❌ R6 detected - R15 only bro?")
        return
    end

    local animateScript = character:WaitForChild("Animate")
    local animator = humanoid:WaitForChild("Animator")

    StopAnimations(character)

    -- set the character walkspeed to 16.5 upon execution
    humanoid.WalkSpeed = 16.5

    -- assign the single desired head bopping idle animation to both slots
    animateScript.idle.Animation1.AnimationId = "rbxassetid://122257458498464"
    animateScript.idle.Animation2.AnimationId = "rbxassetid://122257458498464"

    -- remove or override the third floating pose animation slot if it exists
    if animateScript.idle:FindFirstChild("Animation3") then
        animateScript.idle.Animation3.AnimationId = "rbxassetid://122257458498464"
    end

    -- assign movement and traversal animation assets
    animateScript.walk.WalkAnim.AnimationId = "rbxassetid://122150855457006"
    animateScript.run.RunAnim.AnimationId = "rbxassetid://82598234841035"
    animateScript.jump.JumpAnim.AnimationId = "rbxassetid://75290611992385"
    animateScript.climb.ClimbAnim.AnimationId = "rbxassetid://88763136693023"
    animateScript.fall.FallAnim.AnimationId = "rbxassetid://18537367238"

    -- assign water swimming animation assets
    animateScript.swim.Swim.AnimationId = "rbxassetid://133308483266208"
    animateScript.swimidle.SwimIdle.AnimationId = "rbxassetid://109346520324160"

    -- refresh the humanoid state and re-enable the animate script
    humanoid:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.GettingUp)
    animateScript.Disabled = false

    -- disconnect any previously running loop to prevent duplicates upon respawn
    if currentSpeedConnection then
        currentSpeedConnection:Disconnect()
        currentSpeedConnection = nil
    end

    -- scale up the animation speed slightly from 0.96 to 0.98 for a microscopic speed bump
    currentSpeedConnection = runService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
        if not character or not character.Parent or humanoid.Health <= 0 then
            if currentSpeedConnection then
                currentSpeedConnection:Disconnect()
                currentSpeedConnection = nil
            end
            return
        end

        for _, track in ipairs(animator:GetPlayingAnimationTracks()) do
            local animId = track.Animation and track.Animation.AnimationId
            if animId == "rbxassetid://122150855457006" or animId == "rbxassetid://82598234841035" then
                -- adjust the speed multiplier to make the animation pacing just a fraction faster
                track:AdjustSpeed(0.98)
            end
        end
    end)

    print("✅ Animations, speed 16.5, and respawn persistence applied successfully")
end

-- handle setup for the existing character or wait until one spawns
local function OnCharacterAdded(character)
    character:WaitForChild("Humanoid")
    character:WaitForChild("Animate")
    task.spawn(function()
        task.wait(0.1) -- brief safety delay to let Roblox finish resetting the character state
        ApplyCustomAnimations(character)
    end)
end

if player.Character then
    OnCharacterAdded(player.Character)
end

player.CharacterAdded:Connect(OnCharacterAdded)
